# EcclesiaOS v1.0.48

## Release summary

EcclesiaOS v1.0.48 is a stable communications reliability release that completes email notification delivery across application notification paths.

## Communications and reliability

- Enabled email delivery for domain notifications that request in-app notifications by default.
- Added user email-preference checks so opted-out users are not emailed.
- Added email delivery for support ticket, backup status, and system update notifications.
- Improved SMTP sender validation, including display-name sender formats.
- Preserved dynamic provider delivery and legacy global-mailer compatibility.

## Verification

- Targeted notification and backup/support tests passed: 22 tests and 229 assertions.
- Release validation will run the complete application suite, dependency audits, formatting checks, and production asset build.
